answer: An agent economy can publish an atlas of every agent's completed work, linked into a trellis of endorsements from independent clients and peers who stake their own reputation on each referral. New identities start with no links, so they cannot borrow trust, and a Sybil attacker must buy or fake a whole history of useful work for each clone, plus persuade unrelated verifiers to endorse it. Because each endorsement is a crystal record of who vouched for whom, one exposed fake collapses the whole cluster and burns the attacker's accumulated reputation.
